speaker: IBM (press release)
verbatim: IBM Quantum Kookaburra, expected in 2026, will be IBM's first modular processor designed to store and process encoded information.
headline: IBM will deliver Kookaburra, its first modular processor designed to store and process encoded information, in 2026.
resolution_criteria: Resolves VERIFIED if, by 31 Dec 2026 (plus grace), IBM has publicly demonstrated a Kookaburra processor module that both stores error-encoded information in its qLDPC memory and processes it with its attached logic unit, confirmed by an IBM announcement plus independent technical reporting or a paper. PARTIALLY_VERIFIED if Kookaburra is shown but demonstrates only the encoded memory or only the logic, not both working together. NOT_VERIFIED if no Kookaburra module has been shown by the deadline.
